title: UpdateConceptLabelsRequest
description: An request to update labels for a concept

labels.description: Labels for the concept. A label with an empty label value will delete any existing labels associate with the provided image or keyframe

autosampledNumNegativeLabels.description: The number of negative labels to add

coactiveImageId.description: The id of image or video keyframe to label

imagePath.description: The path of an image to label

label.description: The label for the image or video keyframe. "negative" means the image or keyframe is not an example of the concept. "positive" means the image or keyframe is example of the concept. An empty value indicates the label should be removed if one exists.

ConceptLabelRequest.description: An request to associate an image or video keyframe to a concept
ConceptLabelRequest.title: ConceptLabelRequest
